answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 75 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in jade, queued in echo, and harbor publishes the wait time. A farm of 79 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2281 identities would post 3105 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
